name: pr-assistant
description: Automated review of every pull request in the repos you enroll, run by anthropics/claude-code-action with this plugin's review rubric (/pr-assistant:review). /pr-assistant:install drops one workflow file into a repo and sets its secret and variables; /pr-assistant:rotate lists enrolled repos and rotates a credential across all of them in one pass. Two auth modes chosen by repo variables, with the same workflow file everywhere: personal (subscription OAuth token) or team (HUIT Apigee-fronted Bedrock key). Self-service from gh; no org admin, GitHub App install, or Console setup needed.
